name: MagiClip
author: Tilman Schieber
description: Pick or type a prompt, send the clipboard text through Claude with it, and review the answer before it goes on the clipboard (or replace the clipboard silently).

barWidget.description: Settings for MagiClip: whether answers are shown or replace the clipboard silently, which Claude model to use, and the saved prompts. Settings live in ~/.config/magiclip/config.json; "Show in bar" off hides this button.
